reviews.title: Very good monitors for the price
reviews.comment: Fantastic monitors for the price. I would highly recommend them.
reviews.author: Jeff McDole

reviews.title: Good product 3 out of 4 monitors arrived in perfect condition.
reviews.comment: Im giving these monitors 4 stars, great price for the product. They look great and perform good. I bought 2 of these 2 packs thats 4 monitors. 1 I recieved came with minor damage. Small separation at the top of the screen and it flickers when booting up but, I dont believe its worth the effort to have replaced. The sound quality is not good but I didn't buy them for their sound. Overall. Id buy them again. These are the highest quality monitors I've ever owned. The monitors these replaced were 10+ years old.
reviews.author: Tristen Tooker

reviews.title: Good for the price
reviews.comment: Would give it 5 stars but they don't have remotes, you have to use a physical button oddly placed underneath, so they bounce on the dual mount, the stands were 2 different heights, so couldn't put them side by side on there mounts and one has a dead pixel in it. Picture is decent for the price, there is a definitely seem between them, so doing dual monitor super wide screen leaves a black gap, video response is decent, sound quality could be better, the lights in the back are pretty useless but nice if you can see them
reviews.author: Brad

reviews.title: Height difference in Monitors.
reviews.comment: here's why it gets two stars. One...The monitors are about a quarter almost a half inch different in height. Second...The speakers? If you're looking for sound the built in speakers are only good for playing Midi files...Remember those? As far as the pictures. These screens aren't really that curved. They have a curve but it's not that wrap around level of emersion you get with higher end curved monitors. Not as good as I hoped. But better than what I had which was a 720P Samsung TV. Is the picture better? Eh...Yeah sort of.
reviews.author: Budmiester
